title.narrative: An Integrated Multi-Sectoral Response to conflict affected IDPs recently returned or relocated in , Abe Dongoro district ,Horo Guduru Wellega Zone, Oromia Region

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed action provides immediate humanitarian assistance to conflict-affected returnee communities in the Abe Dongoro district of the Horo Guduru Wellega Zone. The action primarily focuses on 55,776 (30,065 Female) population of IDP returnees, and critically affected host communities, who are experiencing prolonged Conflict impacts in the area. The conflict has manifested itself in huge damage to livelihood assets and service infrastructures, acute food insecurity, unprotected water sources, displacement, and widespread nutrition-related diseases among children under the age of five, lactating mothers, and elders. The breakdown of traditional coping mechanisms is weakened. The proposed action will alleviate the suffering of conflict-affected populations through an integrated humanitarian response that comprises Agriculture, WASH, ES/NFIs and Protection mainstreaming, and Multipurpose Cash Transfer (unconditional). The specific interventions in the Agriculture Cluster are the provision of 105 quintals of Emergency seeds (1 cereal 1 legume 2 vegetables) for 400 HHs supplemented with farming tools 2 months unconditional multipurpose cash transfer for 500 HHs and restocking of 200 HHs women head with 5 goats each to improve their food security and nutrition. Provision of Technical training for 283 people on good agronomic practices crop production, shoat's husbandry, and vaccination support for restocked goats will be provided. WASH sector, Spring capping with two public fountains (Bono) in two returnee sites, Rehabilitation and maintenance of two (2) hand-dug wells for 3700 individuals, provision and installation of six (6) water-storing tankers (Rotos) with 10,000Lit) around public institutions such as schools and health facilities, Construct two(2) latrines segregated by gender in two schools, construction of two (2) solid waste disposal pits, distribution of hand tools for latrine and west disposal pit excavation and earthwork per communal latrine. Distribution of WASH-NFIs for 6000(items like 5000 laundry soaps, body soaps, 500 washing basins,500 buckets, and 500jerry cans for 500 targeted HHs in the target three localities, Distribute water purification chemicals for 600 target HHs in the target three localities who are using water from open sources for three months, Distribution of IEC Materials for of hygiene promotion guideline for hygiene promoters, Provision of Water management committees, WASH-Cos and hygiene promotion volunteers on WASH including water management and maintenance of water infrastructure and sustainability in communities, Provision of Multipurpose cash for 205 HH for WASH NFIs Hygiene Kits for two round as well as in emergency shelter and NFIs cluster, Provision of shelter repairing kits in kind and Cash for rehabilitation of shelter damaged for 503 HH(2707 individuals). Furthermore, the project will consciously mainstream key cross-cutting issues (AAP, Gender, PSEA) across all clusters through practical measures that focus on awareness raising, community consultation, and providing dignity sanitary pads for 200 girls for three months and 100 women and girls victims different violation will be provided with unconditional cash transfer through affirmative actions, and dialogues, Establishing APP working groups, and community complaint handling mechanisms, and roll out. SOS Sahel Safeguarding policy makes an integral part of the mainstreaming actions. Affirmative action will be taken in this design by addressing 100 women and girls for gender-based violence and other abuses with unconditional multipurpose cash transfers. The project will be implemented over 12 months and require USD 1,000,000.00 to achieve its intended objectives of providing critical lifesaving services to affected communities in an integrated manner. The Project will be implemented in consortium with two national and local NGOs (SEED and HUNDEE). SOS Sahel Ethiopia is the lead agency.ltbrgtlt/pgt
